text:
Maya: Dropped a new "mini-strip" onboarding mock in Figma — compact sample-project strip that expands inline instead of a sticky bottom banner. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/mini-strip (frame 'Onboard > Mini Strip'). Thoughts?

Dan: Cleaner visual. My worry: discoverability on small screens when collapsed. How do users notice it?

Jess: Let's A/B collapsed vs expanded for first session. Metrics: sample-start rate and time-to-first-api-key. 5k users per arm?

Sam: Dev note: ensure DOM order so keyboard tabs hit the toggle/CTA before card details. Otherwise tabbing becomes confusing.

Priya: A11y: pill contrast ~3.7:1 in mock — needs 4.5:1. Focus ring too subtle. Also touch target is 36px, must be >=44px.

Maya: Good catches. Microcopy: short label ideas — "Try sample", "Start sample", "Create demo". Mobile prefers shortest.

Jess: "Try sample" is concise and friendly. For enterprise we can use "Create sample project" via org override.

Sam: CSS idea to keep touch targets: .pill { min-height:44px; padding:10px 14px; } and make strip horizontally scrollable.

a11y-bot: Scan flagged missing aria-label on collapse chevron; recommend aria-label="Expand samples" / "Collapse samples".

Priya: Also add aria-live="polite" to onboarding step region so screen reader users get updates when selection advances. Ensure aria-expanded present on toggle.

Maya: I'll update Figma: 1) change pill copy to "Try sample" on mobile, full copy on desktop, 2) bump contrast to meet 4.5:1, 3) annotate a11y notes (aria-live, aria-expanded, aria-labels), 4) show focus styles. Will post new frames tomorrow.

Jess: I'll add analytics events: sample_impression, sample_expand, sample_click, sample_complete. Tag elements with data-qa attributes.

Dan: For enterprise noise, default-off via org setting. Persist user preference per account.

Sam: I'll prepare a tiny PR to reorder DOM so the toggle is the first interactive element in the region and include tabindex handling.

Maya: Thanks — I'll also create a 5-task usability script focused on discovery and keyboard flow and schedule a quick session after I upload new frames.

Dan: :thumbsup:

Priya: One microcopy ask: if we add "(recommended)", keep it visible and test read length for localization.

Maya: Noted. Will include both variants in Figma notes. Thanks all!
